title: Genesis 22:15-16 letter grid: gold "sha" (lamb) boxes cross at the green-boxed ש
summary: The Genesis 22:15-16 letter grid with several tilted gold boxes crossing at the ש in the green-boxed row, pairing it with ה letters just below on either side. The gold labels "sha", שה and "Lamb" sit at the right, level with that crossing. The red column box and blue diagonal box remain.

pictures.description: Grid of Hebrew letters (the text of Genesis 22:15-16 in rows) with purple מלאך, coloured letters of יהוה, a blue diagonal box, a tall red box around a column, a green row box, many gold-coloured ש and ה letters, and tilted gold boxes crossing in a star shape at one ש.

uncertain: Dense letter grid not copied cell by cell; only the highlighted letters and labels are transcribed.
Exactly which letter pairs the overlapping gold boxes enclose is hard to make out.
